title: 只切一个同步分区
premise: 预演通过，审批批准一个分区切换，旧制品已保留。
listeningTask: 识别防止新旧worker重复写入的切换顺序。

lines.en: Approve one canary cohort for this window. The staged rollout starts with one partition.
lines.zh: 本窗口批准一组灰度，分阶段发布从一个分区开始。

lines.en: Drain the old worker before assigning ownership. Two workers mustn't process the same partition.
lines.zh: 先排空旧worker再转移所有权，不能两个worker同时处理该分区。

lines.en: Just to confirm, the lease transfers once, right? I'll verify no overlapping writer remains.
lines.zh: 确认一下，租约只转移一次，对吧？我验证没有重叠写入者。

lines.en: Okay, keep an eye on reconciliation lag. Maybe the first batch warms connections slowly.
lines.zh: 好，关注对账延迟，首批连接预热可能较慢。

lines.en: The smoke test uses this production partition. Compare output counts with its expected inventory.
lines.zh: 冒烟测试针对这个生产分区，把输出计数与预期库存比较。

lines.en: The new worker holds the sole lease. Token refresh and the initial batch pass.
lines.zh: 新worker独占租约，令牌刷新和首批处理通过。

lines.en: State the rollback trigger before further batches. Duplicates or reconciliation mismatches mean immediate pause.
lines.zh: 继续批次前明确回退条件，重复记录或对账不符立即暂停。

lines.en: Agreed, pause and evaluate before reverting ownership. Don't start old workers beside new ones.
lines.zh: 同意，暂停评估后才恢复旧所有权，不能新旧worker并跑。

lines.en: First-batch counts and signatures match expectations. We'll inspect another full token-refresh cycle.
lines.zh: 首批计数与签名符合预期，再检查一个完整令牌刷新周期。

lines.en: I'll own that observation before expansion approval. Healthy startup alone doesn't cover steady-state behavior.
lines.zh: 扩大审批前由我负责观察，仅启动健康不能覆盖稳定运行。

scene: 预演通过，审批批准一个分区切换，旧制品已保留。
accent: 印度英语 60% / 德国英语 40%（场景发声时长）
